item.title: Why Most Efforts Towards “Democratic AI” Fall Short
item.description: A frequent suggestion to resolve public concerns regarding AI is to democratise AI, which on first inspection sounds incredibly attractive. In practice, however, the processes that are typically called for and conducted are superficial at best, and can even be twisted to promote the appearance of egalitarianism without making any meaningful changes.
